Ovulation.22: Kuona zviratidzo izvi mumatanho akati wandei kunokubatsira kuziva marwadzo ako, ayo anogona kusiyana neavhareji huru.
Ovulation.24: Kana nguva yako isiripo kwenguva refu kana kuti usina chokwadi, mazano ekurapa anokurudzirwa.
Ovulation.26: Hapana chiratidzo chimwe chete chakavimbika zvakakwana pachacho: kuvasanganisa kunopa pfungwa iri nani yenguva yako inobudirira zvikuru.

Patch.6: Chinhu chinoshandiswa vhiki nevhiki pane kupiritsi yezuva nezuva.
Patch.12: Chinhu ichi chinoramba chichiita kuti mahormone asununguke kuburikidza neganda, zvichiita sezvinoita mapiritsi akabatanidzwa: chinodzivisa ovulation uye chinoita kuti mucus womutsipa wemuzamu uve wakakura.
Patch.14: Chinhu chikuru chinobatsira ndechokuti hachidi kuti uwane mushonga wezuva nezuva.
Patch.15: Chinhu ichi chinowanzochinjwa kamwe chete pavhiki kwevhiki nhatu, chichichitevera vhiki rimwe chete pasina chinenge chachinjwa.
Patch.19: Zvinhu zvinokosha zvaunofanira kuziva usati washandisa uye paunenge uchishandisa.
Patch.21: Chinhu ichi chinotsiviwa kamwe chete pavhiki.
Patch.23: Inofanira kuiswa paganda rakachena uye rakaoma.
Patch.25: Inoshanda nguva dzose kana yakashandiswa zvakanaka.
Patch.36: Inoda kuti munhu arambe achiita zvaanoda
Patch.38: Kufurirwa kuduku kunogona kuoneka panzvimbo yokushandisa.
Patch.41: Nguva dzose tarisa kuti iri kunamatira zvakanaka.
Patch.42: Kana zvichidiwa, bvunza nyanzvi yezvokurapa kuti ikupe mazano.
